abstract: This paper presents a detection method for BLE receiver which has approximately constant performance under a wide CFO range. To improve performance under large CFO, the presented method divides the whole CFO range into 5 sub-ranges. The CFO range division is performed after correlation through several linear combinations of in-phase and quadrature correlation results. There is no extra correlation in each CFO subrange, which can reduce complexity significantly. The simulation results show that the presented method has stable performance under the whole CFO range a BLE receiver needs to cover.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Log-Based Anomaly Detection Platform Based on ELK+Kafka
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Anomaly detection is vitally essential to modern large-scale distributed systems. Over the years,many log-based anomaly detection methods have been proposed. Logs record the real-time running information of processes in distributed systems and show the running status of the processes. However, when the reliability issues that happen in distributed systems, operators often inspect the logs manually with multi-rule matching and multi-keyword search. Additionally, The increasing scale and complexity of distributed systems, make the volume of logs explode, which renders the infeasibility of manual inspection. To reduce manual effort, we provide a log-based anomaly detection platform, which is based on ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Kafka and deep learning-based methods. Our proposed platform is evaluated using two different publicly-available production log datasets, and our results demonstrate that it achieves the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$F_{1}$</tex>-score of 0.792 and 0.829, respectively, outperforming the manually inspecting log anomalies.

articleTitle: Semantic QoS-aware Resource Allocation for IoV Computation Offloading using Layer Enhanced Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the Internet of Vehicles, computation task offloading is essential to meet increasing computational demands. This paper proposes a resource allocation algorithm based on an enhanced Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) for semantic communication, dynamically allocating resources based on the semantic quality of tasks. We develop a Semantic-Aware Layer Enhanced Whale Optimization Algorithm (LEWOA) that improves multi-dimensional resource allocation by considering the Quality of Service (QoS) of semantic data. Simulations using the YOLO-V8 framework and HRNet are performed to validate the superiority of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Reading Between the Lines: Commonsense Reasoning in Small Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently, large language models have been scaled down from large to smaller parameters. Large language models have generalized to many tasks with pre-training, and these also excelled in commonsense reasoning with targeted fine-tuning. Commonsense reasoning is the capability to make judgments and draw conclusions based on everyday knowledge that humans typically acquire through life experiences. Reasoning ability in language models involves understanding implicit relationships, contextual cues, and causal connections in various scenarios. Despite the progress of large models in many tasks, commonsense reasoning has proved challenging in few-shot settings. In this paper, we propose the evaluation of small language models for commonsense reasoning using the instruction tuning method. We performed experiments on two datasets for commonsense reasoning and evaluated the performance of the models with different quantization processes in one-shot settings. Our results show that the model demonstrates promising results; however, further fine-tuning is required to enhance their commonsense reasoning abilities. Our study contributes to understanding the potential and limitations of small language models.

articleTitle: An Improved Text Similarity Calculation Method Combining TF-IDF and LexRank
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In text similarity calculation, the traditional TF-IDF (Term Frequency Across Document Frequency) method is widely used in text retrieval and information extraction tasks due to its simplicity, ease of understanding, and efficiency. However, the TF-IDF method has certain limitations in handling text semantics and contextual information. To compensate for this deficiency, this study proposes an improved text similarity calculation method combining TF-IDF and LexRank. We improved the TF-IDF weight calculation by introducing feature concentration, thereby enhancing the ability to distinguish keywords. The LexRank algorithm is based on sentence similarity maps and PageRank ideas, further enhancing the ability to capture semantic relationships between sentences. Combining these two methods, we have designed a comprehensive scoring model to evaluate text similarity. The experimental results show that the improved method combining TF-IDF and LexRank performs better in processing text similarity calculations than using TF-IDF or LexRank alone, with higher accuracy and stability. This method has demonstrated significant performance improvement in application fields such as text classification and information retrieval, and has high practical application value.

articleTitle: Acoustic Unit-Based System Empowering Accent Correction Across Low-Resource Languages
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Mainstream accent correction systems still require labeled data during training, which limits the technology to a small fraction of global languages. Particularly challenging is the fact that some languages lack a written form, preventing the generation of necessary textual annotations and thereby blocking the feasibility of traditional supervised learning approaches. Moreover, even existing L2 speech features often do not perfectly match their corresponding textual annotations. These issues highlight the urgency of exploring unsupervised learning methods in the field of accent correction, especially when dealing with low-resource languages and challenging L2 speech feature modeling. Therefore, we propose the Unsupervised Acoustic Unit-based Accent Correction Model (UAU-ACM), which detects and modifies accentuated speech using an unsupervised acoustic unit approach. Experiments conducted on the public KeSpeech dataset comprehensively validate the superiority of our model.

articleTitle: Interference Signal Suppression Algorithm Based on 5G Base Station Single-Channel Transmission Environment Parameter Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the limitation that traditional interference suppression algorithms cannot achieve direct wave signal suppression in single channel and the complexity of their methods when using 5G base stations for target detection of “low, slow and small (LSS)” targets. This study proposes an interference signal suppression algorithm based on single-channel transmission environment parameter sensing (ISSEPS). The ISSEPS is designed to achieve interference signal suppression in a single-channel configuration, thereby reducing the impact of strong interference signals on the detection of low-altitude, slow-moving, and small-sized targets. The ISSEPS begins by obtaining the direct wave signal delay through Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) correlation, followed by setting the search range for the multipath reflected signal delay. A signal amplitude solution model is then established to determine the amplitude coefficients. Finally, the interference signal is reconstructed using a series of environmental parameters to complete the interference signal suppression. Experimental simulations demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively suppress interference signals in a single-channel configuration with relatively low algorithmic complexity, significantly reducing the impact of interference signals on the detection of LSS targets.

articleTitle: Design of ISAC Directional Modulation Exploring Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Directional modulation (DM) is a promising physical layer security technology gaining attention in both academia and industry. This paper presents a design approach for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems using reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS). The method aims to enhance radar target estimation by maximizing the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in the radar direction while maintaining the communication constellation. Additionally, it introduces a mismatch threshold to disrupt unintended signal directions, with the RIS optimizing discrete phase values to improve overall communication and radar performance.

articleTitle: Research on Gesture Recognition Based on Millimeter Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This article proposes a gesture recognition technology for frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) millimeter wave radar [1]. The radar echoes are analyzed and processed, and the distance velocity features of gestures and radar are extracted to obtain distance velocity features [2]. Based on these features, convolutional neural networks are used to recognize and classify the four gestures. In terms of signal processing, distance Doppler images are obtained by extracting distance and velocity features from radar raw signals, which are then used as inputs for deep learning networks [3]. This avoids the problem of high algorithm complexity and data redundancy caused by complex network inputs. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper has certain advantages in recognition accuracy compared to other millimeter wave radar gesture recognition algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on ISAR Imagine of High Frequency Ground Wave Radar in Large Sea Scene
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: High frequency ground wave radar (HF-GWR) is considered as a new and effective technical tool for marine environmental monitoring because of its advantages of beyond visual range, large range and low cost, meanwhile, ISAR (Inverse synthetic Aperture radar) imaging technology has great application value in the strategy of maritime power. In this paper, PM sea spectrum and linear filtering method were used to simulate the wind driven sea surface, and combined with the digital elevation model (DEM), a large sea scene where the island target and the sea surface are combined is successfully constructed. Then, high-frequency numerical electromagnetic calculation method was used to obtain the broadband and large angle echo data of the sea scene. Finally, the echo data are processed by Simpson integral, and the 2D ISAR image of large sea scene with high/low extreme sea conditions at low sweep angle and high frequency band (working conditions of HF-GWR) is obtained successfully. The imaging results show that the contour of island targets and strong scattering points such as ridge lines can be clearly displayed under extreme sea conditions, which has a reference significance for the application of distributed/mobile HF-GWR in 2D ISAR imaging engineering of large sea scene.

articleTitle: Collaborative Space-Time Anti-Jamming for the Uplink of Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the face of increasingly dynamic, varied, and so-phisticated jamming attacks, conventional anti-jamming solutions are insufficient to ensure the reliability of satellite communication systems in a hostile jamming environment, leading to the vulner-ability of communication links. In this paper, a new space-time anti-jamming algorithm based on satellite collaboration is proposed. Firstly, an anti-jamming model for the uplink of satellite communications is developed, in which the inter-satellite collaboration is proposed for adaptive interference cancellation. The proposed method enables efficient joint space-time anti-jamming through the exchange of jamming information between reliable inter-satellite links. Secondly, we formulate the collaborative and joint space-time anti-jamming problem under the constraint of different Doppler shifts of jamming signals between the receiver and its collaborator. To solve this problem, we further propose a phased-array space-time anti-jamming algorithm which is jointly designed by the Doppler shift compensation to the jamming signal. Simulations over four types of jamming signals show the performance improvement and the robustness of the proposed method in anti-jamming compared with conventional phased-array beamforming in satellite communications.

articleTitle: LIGHT-TABLE-CHAIN: Simplifying and Enhancing Chain-Based Table Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The objective of table reasoning tasks is to accurately extract answers from complex tabular data based on specific queries. While chain-based table reasoning methods have proven effective for stepwise inference, traditional approaches often encounter inefficiencies and redundancies due to their re-liance on lengthy and intricate chains of operations that refine the original data. To address these challenges, we propose LIGHT-TABLE-CHAIN, a novel approach that streamlines the reasoning process and enhances overall efficiency. Our method begins by transforming the user query into a target-oriented final table, which serves as a guiding framework for subsequent reasoning operations. We introduce a guided pruning strategy that leverages this final table's structure to iteratively refine and optimize the original data, thereby minimizing unnecessary operations. This method enables large language models (LLMs) to accurately select pruning operations, constructing an efficient pathway while ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the reasoning process. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets, including TabFact and WikiTQ, demonstrate that LIGHT-TABLE-CHAIN achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly surpassing existing methodologies in table reasoning.

articleTitle: High-Fidelity Phase Reconstruction via Neural Networks in Shack-Hartmann Wavefront Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Optical phase detection is crucial in various domains, including optical metrology and biomedical imaging. Conventional phase retrieval methods, such as interferometry and Shack-Hartmann wavefront sensing, are limited by the lens array size, typically producing low-resolution outputs. This study introduces RDSH_Net, a novel neural network architecture that enhances phase retrieval by learning phase information directly from intensity patterns. The network is capable of generating high-resolution phase maps, scaling up to 256 × 256. Experimental results show that RDSH_Net's SSIM and NCC scores are very close to 1, indicating high fidelity, while PSNR values reveal that its outputs are numerically twice as high as those from conventional methods. This work demonstrates the potential of integrating deep learning with wavefront sensing technologies for superior phase resolution and accuracy.

articleTitle: Autotrinity: An Heterogeneous Runner Based Remote Digital System Lab System
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Digital system design lies an important part in modern electronics engineering and computer science, and is usually described in hardware description languages (HDLs), like verilog/system verilog, or VHDL, all of whom have been widely taught and used in industry and academia [1] [2]. In educational purpose, digital system design is usually taught with tools like HDLs and FPGA boards or its simulators. However, FPGA boards are expensive and fragile components, and institutes tends to limit the access to boards in classrooms and labotaries. To ease the conflict between the accessibility and the risk of damaging or losing the FPGA boards, remote lab systems are proposed to provide easier maintainence and 7/24 access to resources like FPGA boards. The paper represents an overview of a remote FPGA laboratory system named autotrinity. Autotrinity is a remote laboratory system providing remote FPGA access. Autotrinity offers a virtual FPGA interface decoupled with actual FPGA device, making it possible to run the same source file on different FPGA resources. Autotrinity also integrates a simple CI/CD system for source file checking and building source HDL files. This can hopefully alleviate the aforementioned issues and provide a better experience for both students and course maintainers.

articleTitle: Linear Complexity of Memory Sequence
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The linear complexity is an important measure of pseudorandomness for binary sequences. Based on the relationship between the minimal polynomial and linear complexity, as well as certain number-theoretic properties, we have established both upper and lower bounds for the linear complexity of memory sequences. Additionally, we have identified a special class of memory sequences and demonstrated that they share the same cryptographic properties as the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\ell$</tex>-sequences from which they are derived.

articleTitle: UAV Vision Based Wind Turbine Blades Defects Detecion via Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The timely maintenance of wind turbine blades is considered of high importance for the safety and effectiveness of Wind power stations. To address the concerns of inefficiencies and safety issue of traditional mannual blade damage detection methods, we employed UAV vision and proposed a novel semantic segmentation model based on DeepLabV3Plus. The major enhancement involved adopting SCTNet as the backbone network and integrating the EMA mechanism. Our experiments indicate that DeepLab V3Plus-SE performs exceptionally well in segmenting wind turbine blades and identifying defects. Moreover, the model shows substantial improvements in key performance metrics, namely mIoU and mAcc.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning and Control Method of Space Servo Manipulator System
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Space manipulator has been widely used in many space missions, including on-orbit docking, construction and maintenance, and astronauts' activities in space. In the aspect of manipulator planning and control, the current research mainly focuses on the motion trajectory planning and stability control of space manipulator, while the research on the space repeatable acquisition and locking technology for adaptive servo of signal source is relatively few. In this study, a space servo manipulator system and an optical path servo control method based on reinforcement learning for the manipulator were designed, so that the space manipulator could adapt to adjust the position of the end load according to the signal changes of the optical path, to complete the tracking of the optical path signal. The feasibility of the system was verified through mathematical simulation and physical objects.

articleTitle: Design of Non-adjacent Chaotic PRNG based on Multi-delay Function
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Pseudorandom number generators (PRNG) play a critical role in the field of information security. Therefore, we propose a novel pseudorandom number generator based on a multi-time-lag non-adjacent coupling lattice, which introduces a new logistic-PWLCM mapping. The resulting chaotic sequence generated by the logistic-PWLCM mapping exhibits improved uniform distribution characteristics and effectively eliminates the issue of chaotic period window. Furthermore, the digital circuit system is susceptible to accuracy degradation, which can adversely affect the chaotic system. Hence, we employ an intact Kalman filter (UKF) to quantify the accuracy loss of Logistic and Chebyshev and compensate for it by introducing perturbations into the locally chaotic system. Through experimental analysis and efficiency evaluation, we demonstrate both high randomness and efficiency in our proposed pseudorandom number generator. Moreover, our pseudorandom generator successfully passes statistical randomness test suites such as NIST SP800-22 and TestU01.

articleTitle: Channel Modeling and Characterization of Typical Flight Scenarios of Low-Altitude Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a channel measurement system suitable for typical flight scenarios of low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is constructed, and a channel measurement algorithm is proposed. Based on this system, the channels of three typical flight scenarios of UAVs are measured, including two line-of-sight (LOS) scenarios and one non-line-of-sight (NLOS) scenario. Then, the channel measurement results are statistically analyzed, and the channel characteristics are analyzed. Finally, the channel model of these typical scenarios is constructed, and the typical parameters such as root mean square delay spread (RMS-DS) and Rice factor are given.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Instrument Detection Model Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In reference to the characteristics of the MobileNet network, a lightweight design method for the YOLOv4 model is proposed. A machine vision object detection model targeting 'dumb sensors' in digital workshops is constructed, and compared with other commonly used object detection models. The performance of the model on the dataset is verified, demonstrating that the model not only ensures detection accuracy but also reduces training and prediction time.

articleTitle: Enhancing Multi-Scale Object Detection with YOLOv8 and Residual Feature Pyramid Networks for Real-Time Urban Scene Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Object detection in complex urban environments requires models capable of handling diverse object scales and appearances with high accuracy and speed. In this paper, we present YOLOv8 with Residual Feature Pyramid Network (FPN), an enhanced model designed to improve multi-scale feature representation and detection robustness. By integrating an Average Residual Pyramid (ARP) into the YOLOv8 framework, our method replaces the standard second FPN layer, addressing limitations in traditional feature pyramids. The ARP module aligns and aggregates feature maps from different resolutions through upsampling and downsampling, forming a unified representation reintroduced via a residual connection, thus enhancing YOLOv8's ability to detect small and large objects with improved spatial consistency. Experimental results on a modified Cityscapes dataset, re-annotated for object detection tasks, show that YOLOv8 with Residual FPN achieves an mAP@50 of 87.2 and a recall of 91.2, with a high FPS of 127, outperforming the baseline YOLOv8 in both precision and speed. These results demonstrate that YOLOv8 with Residual FPN is an effective solution for real-time object detection in dynamic urban scenes, balancing detection accuracy with processing efficiency.

articleTitle: Hardware-Accelerated 1-Bit Quantization Using PyRTL for Efficient Neural Network Design
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: XNOR-Nets, an innovative binary convolutional neural network, is a promising solution to significantly reduce model size and computational complexity while maintaining a high level of accuracy. Despite these advantages, the full potential of XNOR-Nets remains to be explored, especially in terms of hardware acceleration. PyRTL is an embedded hardware design language that describes the architecture of digital hardware, which, combined with Python's versatility in programming, makes PyRTL an ideal candidate for rapid prototyping and customization of XNOR-Net accelerated hardware design tools. This study strives to bridge the gap between the theoretical efficiency of XNOR-Net and its practical applications by exploring the use of PyRTL to design specialized hardware accelerator.

articleTitle: Cross-Cultural Expression Spotting Method Based on Optical Flow and Sliding Window
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: One of the anticipated attributes of artificial intelligence is its ability to possess human-like characteristics, particularly in analyzing and understanding facial emotions. The challenge of the video macro/micro expression Cross-Cultural Spotting (CCS) task lies in the subtlety, brevity, and difficulty of accurately pinpointing micro-expressions. This paper proposes a macro/micro expression spotting framework based on Main Directional Mean Optical-flow (MDMO). The framework amplifies micro-expression motion information, significantly enhancing the recognizability of expression intervals in optical flow feature maps. By employing a sliding window localization method, the framework accurately captures the start and end frames of expressions, enabling effective merging and post-processing of expression intervals. This approach achieves an optimized balance between precision and recall while reducing the false positive rate. Our method achieved state-of-the-art results on the CAS(ME)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and SAMM-LV datasets and secured third place on the MEGC2024 testing set, demonstrating both the effectiveness and transferability capabilities of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/ceasorcaiIMEGC2024

articleTitle: Multifaceted Assessment and Resolution of Hallucinations in Large Visual-Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The field of Large Visual-Language Models (LVLMs) has made significant strides in integrating visual recognition and language understanding. However, its application in multimodal decision-making and open-ended generation is still constrained by the illusion that generated text does not accurately reflect the visual content. Current benchmarks for assessing LVLMs hallucinations predominantly focus on object hallucinations, thus limiting their scope. In light of this, we constructed the Multifaceted Hallucination Evaluation Bench (MHEB) as a tool to comprehensively assess hallucinations in LVLMs. The MHEB provides an in-depth assessment along four dimensions: Object Detection, Count and Locate, Common Sense Confusion, and Style Adaptation. Our assessment revealed that a model's superior performance on one task does not necessarily indicate its performance on others. In particular, LVLMs demonstrated suboptimal performance on tasks requiring the understanding of common-sense concepts and the identification of fine-grained details. To address the visual hallucination problem, we propose the Visual Contrast Enhancement (VCE), which effectively alleviates hallucinations in LVLMs by comparing original and processed visual information without requiring additional training. Experiments demonstrate that VCE significantly improves the accuracy of visual information.

articleTitle: Network Coded Multiple Access Enhanced Vehicular Visible Light Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Visible light communications (VLC) have demonstrated its Electro-magnetic Interference (EMI) immune capability for truck platooning for intelligent transportation in Japan's highway. However, practical traffic scenarios like lane change may lead to the decrease of reliability between two vehicles due to imperfect alignment such as lateral shift and angle offset, which is an important issue in Vehicle to Vehicle VLC (V2V-VLC) systems. Especially in systems that utilizing multiple Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) to transmit multiple spatial streams, this issue in the reliability will reduce the throughput of the system. In this paper, we propose a Network Coded Multiple Access (NCMA) enhanced V2V-VLC system to improve the performance of the system transmitting two spatial streams. Compared to conventional system, the proposed V2V-VLC system can improve the average normalized throughput in lane change scenario by 28%, 32%, 26% and 12% at the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of 5 dB, 6 dB, 7 dB and 8 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Optimization Scheme of Micro-front-End Architecture Based on Dynamic Cloud Components and Web Components
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a micro-front-end architecture optimization scheme combining dynamic cloud Components and Web Components is proposed to solve the problems of complex component management, poor cross-framework compatibility and inadequate component isolation in enterprise digital management platform. The cloud management platform enables dynamic component loading and on-demand distribution, which improves system performance and flexibility. The encapsulation nature of Web Components ensures cross-framework compatibility, while JS sandbox technology provides greater security for component isolation. In experiments, the proposed scheme significantly reduces the load time of components, and shows stable resource occupancy and security under high concurrency conditions. The results show that the architecture has good scalability and practicability in complex enterprise application scenarios.

articleTitle: Spiking Neural Network Based Nonlinear Equalizer for Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a spiking neural network-based nonlinear equalization algorithm for optical communication is proposed and validated in a 64-QAM coherent optical communication system. Compared with other traditional artificial neural network algorithms, the spiking neural network has a lower computational complexity

articleTitle: A Method for Constructing the Knowledge Graph of Digital Twin Power Facilities Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We propose a method for constructing the knowledge graph of digital twin power facilities based on deep learning to solve the problem which is difficult to effectively manage and apply complex and diverse information of power facilities. This method systematically integrates structured data and unstructured data such as facility attributes, functions, locations, operating status, and detection status, generates digital twin models of power facilities. It constructs knowledge graph through entity recognition and fills in the lacks in the knowledge graph. The experiments show that the accuracy of entity recognition by this method reaches 90.89%, and the accuracy of knowledge graph completion is 83.8%. Finally, we constructed the knowledge graph of digital twin power facilities. This knowledge graph contains 29564 entities and 104615 relationships, with entity recognition accuracy of 81.68% and relationship recognition accuracy of 79.35%. This knowledge graph can serve as the core of data and model management for our power facility digital twin platform for model management and facility retrieval.

articleTitle: Differential Privacy-based Avatar Update in Cooperative Intelligent Transportation System Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Metaverse is the next generation and the successor to the Internet. Various sectors allocated capital to adapt the metaverse due to its inherent importance. Cooperative Intelligent Transportation Systems (C-ITS) is one of the important sectors that can benefit from metaverse adaptation and integration. The C-ITS and metaverse integration give rise to new use cases and cyber attacks. However, traditional Pseudonym Certificate (PCert) authentication based on Vehicular Public Key Infrastructure (VPKI) cannot meet the new use cases and thwart cyber attacks. We present a Differential Privacy (DP)-based PCert and avatar update model to ensure the privacy of end-devices (e.g., vehicles) in the C-ITS metaverse. The proposed DP-based model adds noise to avatar attributes (e.g., color, behavior) to prevent avatar linkage during the PCert update process. Our method ensures that PCerts and avatars cannot be linked to end-devices and the previous PCerts and avatars. We simulate the DP-based method to investigate it in terms of privacy, latency, color distortion, and adversarial success rate, and the results show that DP-based is effective and practical for avatar updates.

articleTitle: GMCB: An Efficient and Light Graph Analysis Model for Detecting Carpet Bombing DDoS Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Carpet Bombing is a hard-to-detect and more damaging Distributed Denial of Service(DDoS) attack that has dramatically increased in recent years, posing a significant threat to various network infrastructures. Unlike traditional DDoS that attacks only a single IP address, Carpet Bombing attacks target multiple IP addresses within the same subnet. And the low rate but high number of Carpet Bombing usually makes it difficult for traditional DDoS detection systems to detect. In this paper, we propose a detection model for Carpet Bombing, which consists of three phases: graph construction, graph simplification and anomaly detection. In the first two stages, we classify the traffic flows and cluster them to form various graphs where vertices and edges contain the source IPs, destination IPs, and interaction patterns of the traffic flows. Moreover, we remove some vertices and edges in the graph to ensure that the model has high detection efficiency in detecting Carpet Bombing. In the last stage, we select the key vertices and then analyse the interaction patterns of various traffic flows and data distribution characteristics for anomaly detection. To test our model, we get a Carpet Bombing detection dataset by mixing the CICDDoS2019 and MAWI datasets with modifications. And experimental results show that our model significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art detectors for DDoS attacks, with AUC and F1 values of 0.9894 and 0.9927, respectively. Moreover, our model consumes less system resources(mainly memory and CPU) compared to other models.

articleTitle: Joint Localization Algorithm Based on TDoA and Carrier Phase with ARP Error Calibration
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Carrier phase positioning is currently a high-precision positioning method in 5G systems, with centimeter-level positioning capabilities demonstrated in ground-based positioning systems. However, indoor positioning accuracy may be significantly negatively affected by unexpected shifts in antenna locations. This paper proposes a joint positioning estimation algorithm based on Time-Difference-of-Arrival (TDoA) and carrier phase measurements, utilizing a particle swarm optimization algorithm to accurately determine the position of the mobile terminal while mitigating the impact of antenna reference point (ARP) location errors on the positioning process, thereby achieving high-precision indoor positioning. System simulation experiments demonstrate that this method can achieve centimeter-level positioning performance in indoor positioning systems.

articleTitle: Data-to-Text: A Constrained Approach to Diverse Candidate Text Generation and Ranking
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Data-to-text (D2T) generation is a crucial NLP task, where transformer-based language models excel at understanding complex relationships and contextual dependencies in structured input data. However, the decoding process in text generation poses a challenge, as the generated text quality is sensitive to the decoding method, often trading off between diversity and accuracy. We propose a novel multi-step approach that leverages constrained randomness through top-p and top-k sampling to generate multiple candidate outputs. These candidates are then evaluated using learning-based models and ranked to select the top-ranked output. Our extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach in producing diverse and accurate text, with significant implications for advancing human-like dialogue systems.

articleTitle: MACLog: Multi-Algorithm Collaborative Log Parsing Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Log parsing approach is capable of converting the raw log into the structured data, which is an important foundation for analyzing logs. Due to the diversity of log types, there is a diversity of log parsing approachs. Furthermore, there is no an approach that can handle all logs well. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi algorithm collaborative log parsing approach, which we call MACLog. MACLog utilizes log recognition algorithms to identify the types of logs to be processed, and generates collaborative strategies based on a knowledge graph for log anomaly detection, thereby implementing multi algorithm collaboration. We use the logs provided by LogHub as the experimental dataset. The experimental results indicate that MACLog can effectively improve the accuracy of log parsing.

articleTitle: Electrostatic Sensing-Based Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Addressing issues such as compromised privacy, blind spots, strict environmental requirements, and high sensor costs in non-contact human activity recognition, this paper proposes a method that uses electrostatic induction to capture human activity. The method involves the analysis and processing of voltage signals induced by human activities via electrostatic induction, and achieves automatic recognition and monitoring of human actions using a 1D-CNN algorithm. The proposed method was tested in natural indoor environments, employing an 8 cm electrode to recognize human activity within a range of 1.5 meters. Experimental results demonstrate an identification accuracy of 80.8%, validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: An Resignation Prediction Method Based on KTE-SMOTE
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the data imbalance problem in employee resignation prediction, this paper proposes a method based on the improved SMOTE algorithm. The data imbalance problem is one of the main challenges in employee resignation prediction, and the traditional SMOTE algorithm often suffers from sample generation bias and over-generation of samples in the central region when dealing with imbalanced data, which leads to poor performance of the prediction model. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a KTE-SMOTE algorithm, which improves the stability of the algorithm by introducing the k-means algorithm, selecting the optimal number of clusters k by using Silhouette Coefficient, combining with under-sampling of Tomek Links, and smoothing the boundary when generating samples by edge smoothing technique. Finally, ENN is used for data cleaning to ensure the diversity of generated samples and the clarity of boundary samples. The experimental results show that the KTE-SMOTE algorithm exhibits better performance than the traditional SMOTE algorithm in a variety of machine learning models.

articleTitle: An Anomaly Detection Method for Conveyor System Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the continuous evolution of the Internet of Things (IoT), it drives the ongoing advancement of industry. The widespread application of IoT enables factories to achieve intelligent production management, thus enhancing factory production efficiency. With complex factory equipment and expanding production scale, diverse anomalies are challenging to identify using traditional methods. To address these issues, digital twin technology can realize real-time monitoring of production to help managers deal with anomalies promptly, thus improving the accuracy of anomaly detection. Taking the factory conveyor equipment as the research object, a factory-oriented anomaly detection method based on digital twin is proposed to improve the productivity and safety of the conveyor. Firstly, we propose the design of a digital twin module for anomaly detection. This module facilitates the interaction and visualization of data between the physical entity and virtual system, thereby guiding the normal operation of the production process. Secondly, we have developed an anomaly detection method to tackle the issue of class imbalance and explore the correlation of time-series data. The experimental results demonstrate that the anomaly detection method, driven by the digital twin, effectively identifies equipment anomalies.

articleTitle: Study on the Approximation Method to Determine Health Evaluation Indicators of CNC Drive Based on Rough Set Theory and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In view of the large number of health evaluation indexes of CNC drives and the large amount of data which leads to a complicated calculation process and a long time consuming problem an evaluation index simplification method based on rough set and genetic algorithm is proposed to achieve the purpose of index simplification. Firstly according to the principle of indicator establishment the evaluation indicators are determined initially; based on the rough set and genetic algorithm the specific steps and methods of the algorithm are given; finally the simplified evaluation indicators are derived. Combined with the case of health evaluation indexes of CNC drives for analysis it not only achieves the purpose of reducing the workload of data collection and calculation but also ensures the accuracy of the results.

articleTitle: A Distributed Data Integration Fault Tolerant Platform for Performance Optimization in Shooting Sports
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In today’ s fast-paced and highly competitive landscape, there is an ever-growing need to enhance the precision, agility, and overall performance of athletes, especially in sports that demand high levels of accuracy and coordination, such as shooting. With the rapid advancement of technology, the role of data analytics in athletic training has gained substantial attention, serving as a powerful tool to elevate athlete performance. This study aims to develop an integrated data platform to support a more precise and holistic approach to training for shooting athletes. By seamlessly combining various types of response and performance data - such as manual reaction times, shooting response times, eye-tracking data, video analyses, and biomechanical data-with a distributed Elasticsearch (ES) data synchronization system, the platform enables comprehensive data collection and analysis. This integration provides invaluable insights into the training status and individual differences of athletes, offering scientific, data-driven guidance for coaches. Furthermore, a robust distributed disaster recovery system is implemented by synchronizing two Elasticsearch clusters with a MySQL database. Although the primary and backup switch mechanisms are still under development, an automated script continuously monitors system health, allowing for rapid failover to backup clusters when necessary. This research opens new avenues in the application of data-driven platforms for athletic performance enhancement, providing a resilient infrastructure for continuous, uninterrupted data analytics, and setting a foundation for future enhancements in sports training methodologies.

articleTitle: An Attention-BiGRU Based Power Generation Forecasting Method for Multi-Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The high complexity, nonlinearity, and data heterogeneity of multi-energy systems (MES) pose significant challenges in power generation forecasting. To solve these problems, a novel power generation forecasting method is proposed, leveraging a bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) integrated with an attention mechanism. First, considering the heterogeneity of environment information data, one-hot encoding is employed to convert all environment information data into numerical features, supplemented by a feature weighting mechanism to assess the significance of each feature. Secondly, considering the intricate temporal correlations within the features, a multi-layer attention mechanism is proposed to facilitate the multidimensional extraction of key features, thereby enhancing the model's ability to capture contextual relationships in time-series sequences. Finally, a BiGRU based encoder-decoder architecture is utilized to predict the power generation value in MES. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves the prediction accuracy compared to baseline schemes.

articleTitle: An Improved Beam Switching Genetic Algorithm for LEO Multi-Beam Satellite Constellation
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to reduce inter-beam interference and resource wastage caused by beam overlap of low earth orbit (LEO) multi-beam satellite constellation, an improved beam switching genetic algorithm (BSGA) is proposed. Firstly, by analyzing the Iridium constellation multi-beam system, a global digital model of the constellation, multi-beam, overlapping coverage, and beam switching optimization problem is established sequentially. To improve the practical engineering usability of the algorithm, the actual pattern is used instead of the traditional spot beam for coverage analysis. Then, a genetic algorithm with optimization control strategy is proposed, to efficiently solve the beam switching problem (BSP). By analyzing the law of beam overlap after constellation networking to control the optimization direction, the convergence of the BSGA is accelerated. Simulation results show that the proposed BSGA can effectively minimize the inter-beam interference and resource wastage of LEO multi-beam satellite constellation. This phenomenon shows that the proposed BSGA can be widely used in the dynamic management of large-scale LEO satellite networking communication.

articleTitle: Alipay Top Up Problem: A Case Study of Algorithms Make a Better Decision
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Alipay is one of the most popular mobile payment platforms that has been widely used all over the world, especially in China. An Alipay account could link many debit cards to top up Alipay's balance. This paper studies an Alipay account topping up the problem with an unknown balance debit card to transfer all the money from the debit card to the Alipay account. This paper applied a binary search algorithm, random search algorithm, and hybrid algorithm for solving the studied problem. We also developed a web-based simulation tool to analyze human behavior when they top up their Alipay with an unknown balance debit card. A case study is conducted on 58 students from Zhengzhou University. From the experiments, we find that students with knowledge of algorithms will be more effective compared with those without learning algorithms,

articleTitle: Intelligent Node Selection for Ad Hoc Networks-Assisted CBTC Systems Based on Proximal Policy Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the advancement of rail transit, communication-based train control (CBTC) system has attracted great attention. Due to the rapid movement of the train, traditional communication technologies cannot meet the requirements of safe handover between access points (AP) and trains. Meanwhile, the deployment of traditional networks requires the support of core network equipment and optical fibers, which is costly and complex. In this paper, flexible ad hoc network is applied as a novel technology in the train-to-train (T2T) communications. Wayside nodes are deployed to assist the situation where the distance between two trains exceeds the communication range of a single-hop distance. To ensure the throughput of the transmission link and minimize energy consumption, a multi-hop node selection strategy plays a vital role in ad hoc networks. Therefore, a proximal policy optimization (PPO)-based routing strategy is presented to deal with the node selection problem in different states. In the simulation, the results illustrate that the proposed node selection strategy is superior to other strategies in terms of optimizing energy and throughput.

articleTitle: Online Learning Customer Churn Prediction Model Based on GA-XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The online education industry faces a significant challenge with high customer churn rates, making it crucial for companies to effectively predict churn and implement retention strategies. This study develops a customer churn prediction model using an optimized XGBoost algorithm, aiming to identify potential churners in advance and offer actionable solutions to address churn. To optimize the XGBoost model's hyperparameters, five tuning techniques were employed: Random Search, Grid Search., Bayesian Optimization, Gradient Optimization., and Genetic Algorithms. The optimal parameter combination was identified, and the time taken for each tuning process was recorded to assess model efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate that the optimized model performs excellently in F1 score, AUC, and other metrics, significantly enhancing the accuracy of churn predictions. Additionally, the analysis of tuning speeds across different algorithms improves the efficiency of model optimization.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Optimization for 5G Base Stations Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of 5G mobile internet, the large-scale deployment of 5G base stations has led to a significant increase in energy consumption. Traditional deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods face significant challenges due to the immense search space, often resulting in local optima. To address these issues, this paper proposes an innovative Deep Reinforcement Learning-based framework for Online Base Station Switching Decisions(DRLOS), which quantifies base station switching decisions and optimizes action selection, significantly reducing the action space and improving the algorithm's convergence performance and computational efficiency. As an online algorithm, DRLOS dynamically generates base station switching decisions based on real-time traffic variations and optimizes bandwidth and power allocation. The numerical results show that compared with existing distributed multi-agent RL algorithm, the proposed algorithm reduces energy consumption by 58.37%.

articleTitle: An Airport Video Information Fusion Method Based on A-SMGCS
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To solve the problem that current civil aviation airport surface surveillance technology can't visually display the target, an airport video information fusion method based on A-SMGCS is proposed. Firstly, the actual GPS coordinates of the target are obtained by A-SMGCS. In addition, the pixel coordinates position of the target in the video image are obtained based on the actual GPS coordinates of the target and the pre constructed mapping relationship table between GPS coordinates and pixel coordinates. Moreover, the real-time video of the target is correlated and displayed based on the pixel coordinates position. Finally, the associated display of video image in A-SMGCS is achieved. The experiment on typical airport shows that the proposed method can not only make the information display of A-SMGCS more vivid and intuitive, but also can meet the requirement for increasing the aircraft capacity of future airport.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Deep Learning-Based Distributed Photovoltaic Power Forecasting System
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the global shift towards renewable energy and the pursuit of “dual-carbon” targets [1], the integration of distributed photovoltaic (PV) power generation into the grid poses significant challenges to power system stability and economic viability. Addressing the limitations of existing forecasting methods, which often focus on individual PV stations and lack a comprehensive approach to regional-scale integration, this study introduces a novel power forecasting system. We systematically investigate the impacts of distributed PV on grid stability and develop an advanced forecasting approach that enhances both prediction accuracy and operational efficiency. Our approach begins with an analysis of spatial correlations between centralized and distributed PV stations within the same region. By identifying and aggregating groups of distributed stations that exhibit significant correlations with centralized ones [2], we create virtual centralized stations. This innovative strategy refines the forecasting model and significantly boosts its accuracy. We then propose a combined LSTM- Transformer model for power output forecasting of these virtual stations. This model capitalizes on the sequence prediction capabilities of LSTM and the long-range dependency capturing efficiency of the Transformer, thereby enhancing forecast precision [3]. Through empirical analysis using real data from PV stations in Northeast China, we confirm the effectiveness of our model. It provides accurate forecasts essential for power system scheduling and aids in decision-making for PV station planning, construction, and operation. This study not only advances the field of distributed PV power generation but also optimizes electrical resource allocation and promotes the green transformation of energy structures.

articleTitle: Length-Variable Prototype Filter Design for the PAPR-Reduced FBMC System
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To flexibly design prototype filters for the PAPR-reduced FBMC system, i.e., the pruned DFT spread FBMC system, this paper proposes a weighted cost function considering perfect reconstruction and out-of-band energy. For minimization, the original fourth-order function is transformed into a second-order function, which is then optimized by an iterative least-square (ILS) algorithm. In this proposed method, the filter length is variable and no more limited as in OQAM-FBMC. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the method. Performance tradeoffs can be aroused by changing the weighting factor and the filter length. Consequently, the proposed method can be used to design filters with comparable performances to its competitors. It is also possible to design longer filters with better BER or shorter filters that perform better in PAPR, system latency and complexity. In our designs with filter length no more than the subcarrier number plus three, the system BER and PAPR are improved. Meanwhile, the system complexity and latency caused by the prototype filter are reduced. To a certain extent, due to the variable filter length and weighting factor, the proposed method gives the flexibility to design filters for different performance needs.

articleTitle: Complex Scene Random Bin Picking Algorithm Based on YOLOv8-TripletAttention
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the fields of robotic operations and automated manufacturing, random bin picking is a challenging and crucial task. This paper proposes a method for workpiece pose estimation based on the combination of YOLOv8 and the Triplet Attention module, designed for random bin picking in complex scenarios. The method utilizes an RGB-D camera to capture color and depth images of the workpiece. By introducing the efficient and lightweight Triplet Attention module, the model achieves a significant improvement in detection and segmentation accuracy without compromising the running speed. Specifically, the Triplet Attention module enhances the spatial attention mechanism by employing three-way rotational convolutions, leading to notable improvements in detection and segmentation precision. The segmented mask is applied to the depth image to extract the corresponding point cloud data, and a six-degree-of-freedom pose estimation is performed using the Normal Distributions Transform (NDT) algorithm, which excels in the presence of noise and partial occlusions. Experimental results show that, compared to the original YOLOv8 model, the model with the Triplet Attention module demonstrates improvements in segmentation precision and recognition accuracy. This method exhibits high accuracy and robustness in workpiece recognition and pose estimation, making it suitable for real-time industrial applications.

articleTitle: DS-PPO: A Reinforcement Learning Method for Wargaming
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Wargame environments present unique challenges for reinforcement learning algorithms due to their large-scale state-action spaces, environmental asymmetry, and high random-ness. To address these challenges, this paper proposes DS-PPO, an improved reinforcement learning algorithm. DS-PPO incorpo-rates dual state input and action masking mechanisms to enhance the agent's perception of the environment and prevent invalid actions. Additionally, a redesigned loss function promotes policy ex-ploration and reduces instability. Experimental results demon-strate that DS-PPO outperforms other algorithms, achieving a win rate of 56.15%.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv8 for Small Object Detection in Aerial Drone Images
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The detection of diminutive targets in UAV aerial images has many important roles and application values. However, due to the small targets and complex terrain occlusions, accurately detecting these targets in UAV images remains challenging. This paper explores effective architectural designs and improve the benchmark model YOLOv8n through three strategies to ensure the increase of detection accuracy without additional computational and parameter overhead. Firstly, an improved C2f module is introduced, which uses partial convolution in place of traditional convolution to reduce model parameters and improve processing speed, and combines Triplet Attention improve the model's capability in understanding complex scenes. Secondly, a specialized header designed for 160x160 small target detection has been integrated into the Neck network. Additionally, ASFF feature fusion technology is employed to dynamically optimize the feature hierarchy using adaptive weights, enhancing the utilization of detailed information. Finally, the SPPF module is optimized by introducing a 13x13 average pooling layer and LSKA large separable kernel attention mechanism, significantly enhancing feature expression of small targets. Compared with YOLOV8n, the improved algorithm on the VisDrone2019 dataset improves mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95 by 2.67% and 2.25%, respectively, while the number of parameters decreases by 11.7%.Experimental results confirm that these optimizations substantially improve detection accuracy and speed for small and medium-sized objects in UAV imagery, validating the effectiveness and practicality about these proposed improvements.

articleTitle: Neural Network Accelerator Architecture Designed for Next Generation Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the future 6G wireless communication networks, the artificial intelligent (AI) technology is a promising way to fundamentally reconstruct the future communication system. However, the AI method always requires a large number of parameter loading and calculation operations, which impose strict requirement on computing capability and data bandwidth of the system. Aiming to implement the existing deep learning algorithms for wireless communication more efficiently, in this paper, we propose an novel AI accelerator architecture, which is driven by data streams and separates computing and control. An affinity compiler and a supporting emulator are designed for this architecture, which meets most of the neural network inference acceleration requirements. Simulation results show that various neural network for wireless communication can be accelerated efficiently.

articleTitle: A Visual Crawler Based on Collection Template Configuration
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the popularization of the Internet and the explosive growth of information, users are faced with the problem of mining and managing massive amounts of data. Traditional crawler systems have certain bottlenecks in configuration, operation and maintenance, which require users to have a high level of technical skills and need to write complex codes to define data extraction rules. This study aims to design and implement a visual crawler system that enables users to easily collect information without in-depth technical knowledge by means of a graphical interface and collection template configuration.

articleTitle: Bringing Efficiency and Applicability to User-Defined Functions by WebAssembly
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the continuous evolution of database technology, numerous databases and query analysis engines have begun to incorporate user-defined functions into SQL. These functions enable users to express their unique data processing logic. However, Python, being the most commonly used language for implementing such functions, faces certain performance and applicability challenges. In this paper, we propose the utilization of WebAssembly for implementing user-defined functions. WebAssembly offers significant performance advantages over Python and supports compilation from multiple languages, thereby allowing users to leverage their preferred programming languages for writing user-defined functions. This approach enhances the overall applicability of user-defined functions. Furthermore, we introduce several performance optimization strategies for WebAssembly-based user-defined functions. These include leveraging a sophisticated user-defined functions execution engine, employing JIT compilation, and utilizing vectorization technology. These optimizations contribute significantly to enhancing the performance of WebAssembly-based user-defined functions.

articleTitle: A Load Balancing Network Based on Dynamic Traffic Partitioning
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Modern networks require high capacity, robustness, and error tolerance, but the currently popular IGP single home network cannot possess these features. an EBGP network with double exits are proposed, it can achieve load balancing of traffic and send network business data quickly and securely. At the same time, a bandwidth partitioning algorithm was developed, the algorithm divides traffic based on the MED and local preference attributes of the EBGP protocol to achieve load balancing of network traffic. Finally, a network system was constructed, and all operational parameters such as latency, jitter, and packet loss were normal, the results well met the needs of the network.

articleTitle: Density-Sensitive Gaussian Mixture Model for Multi-Object Data Association
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The establishment of data association is a vital component to ensure the real-time and precision of object tracking. In view of the deficiency of real-time and precision of traditional data association algorithms, this paper proposes a new data association model named density-sensitive Gaussian mixture model (DSGMM) to achieve multi-object data association tasks. To be specific, the multi-target association is first formulated as a clustering problem based on the Gaussian mixture model. Then, the proposed method establishes bidirectional constraint and confirmation matrix constraint criteria to correct the interconnection probability of the association model, aiming to improve the accuracy and efficiency of data association. Further, the idea of relative density is introduced to enhance the association probability of object points and weaken the association probability of clutter and noise, thereby improving the association accuracy. A series of simulation experiments illustrate that the proposed method is superior to some state-of-the-art data association methods.

articleTitle: Low Distortion Database Watermarking Based on Attribute Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the digital era, databases are increasingly used in the fields of healthcare, education, economics, and trade, but the open sharing of high-value databases also brings the risk of copyright infringement. Database watermarking technology proves copyright ownership by embedding digital watermarks in databases. Existing database watermarking schemes mostly embed watermarks by modifying the attribute values, resulting in data distortion to a certain degree. In the existing methods, there is a category of database watermarking methods that use two separate carrier data for watermark embedding, which enhances the watermark capacity and invisibility. Through theoretical analysis, it is found that the data distortion caused by this category of method is proportional to the difference between the carrier data. Based on this conclusion, this paper proposes a low-distortion database watermarking scheme based on attribute prediction to reduce the data distortion caused by the watermark embedding process. For each selected attribute value y, we use the random forest model to obtain its predicted value <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\hat{y}$</tex> and use <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$y$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\hat{y}$</tex> as two carrier data for watermarking embedding, since the prediction error (the difference between the attribute value and its predicted value) is small, the distortion caused by watermark embedding process should also be small. Experimental results confirm our theoretical analysis and the distortion caused by the proposed scheme is only 30 % of the current optimal database watermarking scheme.

articleTitle: Anti-Jamming Communication Waveform Decision Method with Considering Waveform and Jamming Feature Jointly
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aim at the problem of efficient and reliable transmission for communication system in complex electromagnetic environment, an anti-jamming communication waveform decision method with considering waveform and jamming feature jointly is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the minimum signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) required to meet a specific bit error rate (BER) is adopted as a key indicator to characterize the adaptability between the waveform and the channel environment, and the rating matrix can be constructed accordingly. Then, based on the modeling and transformation of the anti-jamming decision problem, the anti-jamming decision algorithm based on collaborative filtering (CF) is proposed to solve the problem. The main challenge that we have solved is to predict transmission performance ratings that have not yet rated by learning waveform features and jamming features collaboratively and synchronously. Finally, the convergence speed and prediction accuracy of the proposed algorithm are verified by simulation, and the influence of different feature quantities and different data deficiency degrees on the stability and accuracy of the algorithm is discussed.

articleTitle: Carrier Phase Localization with Single Antenna: A Virtual Array Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the release of 3GPP Release 18, Carrier Phase Positioning (CPP) has emerged as a pivotal technology in 5G positioning. However, the current CPP algorithms typically require the coordination of multiple base stations or antennas for effective localization, which limits their applicability in scenarios where only single-antenna devices are available. To adress this problem, we integrate carrier phase positioning with virtual array technology to propose a novel method that enables accurate localization using single-antenna terminals. Unlike traditional multi-antenna localization approaches, our method eliminates the need for time synchronization and spatial resolution, offering greater flexibility and adaptability across various scenarios. Additionally, we conducted real-world experiments using software-defined radio equipment, and the results confirmed the algorithm's feasibility.

articleTitle: GNSS+ VCXO +Atomic Clock: Applied to Communication and Navigation Fusion Satellites' Time and Frequency System
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: VCXO has low cost and good short stability characteristics, but the long-term stability index is poor, which cannot guarantee the frequency accuracy of communication and navigation satellites in a long time. This paper presents a highly continuous, highly stable, integrated time-frequency system: GNSS+ VCXO+ Atomic clock, which is used to generate satellite time and frequency reference. This time-frequency scheme not only takes into account the long-term stability characteristics of the atomic clock, but also uses GNSS to tame the VCXO with excellent short-term stability and low cost. The design results show that the comprehensive index of the time-frequency system is better, the accuracy of the atomic clock (working clock) is better than 3.80E-10, the stability is better than 9.18E-14/1000s, the accuracy of the GNSS+ VCXO (hot standby clock) is better than 5.0E-11, which can be applied to the communication and navigation fusion satellite in engineering.

articleTitle: High-Precision Detection and Classification of Pneumonia Cases Based on Optimized ResNet
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper attempts to classify images of pneumonia patients using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) [2]. The classification model is constructed based on a large number of real X-ray images of both pneumonia patients and healthy individuals. In this study, the model structure is optimized based on the Residual Neural Network (ResNet), resulting in an improvement in test set accuracy from 78.7% to 93.1% [4]. Additionally, a comparative analysis was conducted on CNN, ResNet, and Vision Transformer (VIT) in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and AUC [5]. The improved ResNet achieved an accuracy of 98.5% on the training set and 93.1% on the test set, demonstrating excellent performance.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Scheduling Strategy for Electric Vehicles Considering Multi-Area Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) technology refers to the technology of electric vehicles (EVs) to send electricity to the grid, and it focuses on using the stored energy of a large number of electric vehicles as a buffer between the grid and renewable energy. Although some optimal V2G scheduling of EVs for grid peak demand management have been discussed in recent years, the scheduling scheme of charging and discharging between multiple areas by taking advantage of the mobility of EVs has not been studied much. In this paper, we construct a simplified model of multiple power supply areas with several electric vehicles available, and design a dynamic scheduling strategy to optimize the behavior of each EV, which aiming at reducing the overload and transportation costs. With the scheduling strategy we proposed, the global optimal solution of this problem can be found. The simulation results show that our dynamic scheduling strategy can significantly reduce the total costs of the multi-EV multi-area system.

articleTitle: Exploration of Large Language Model Application in University Information Service Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To address the challenges posed by the growing volume of data and the increasing complexity of user interface navigation in university information systems, this paper introduces a novel data processing framework that integrates large language models (LLMs). The proposed system enhances user interaction through natural language communication, thereby improving both the user experience and adaptability. By leveraging LLM technology, the system streamlines various tasks, including document referencing, database querying, question answering, and data visualization, significantly increasing the efficiency of information retrieval and accessibility for institutional staff. Its high portability and cost-effectiveness render it a promising solution for educational institutions. A pilot implementation has demonstrated the system's capability to comprehend, analyze, and generate accurate responses to user inquiries by leveraging data tables and policy documents.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of Nodes in Cloud Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The cloud platform is made up of a series of computing nodes and storage nodes. The timely detection and remediation of node anomalies in the cloud is of critical importance. Traditional anomaly detection methods struggle to effectively manage discontinuous changes in node status. To address this issue, we propose a method for anomaly detection of multidimensional time series data based on pre-trained models and transferring the problem to the image domain, named Sequence to Image Anomaly Detection (StI-AD). This method implements a multidimensional data anomaly detection method based on visual domain pre-training models. By transforming time series data into polar coordinates, the temporal correlation of the coordinates can be reflected. A series of experiments show that this method has a 5–7 percent improvement in accuracy compared to traditional anomaly detection methods and significantly shortens the model training cycle.

articleTitle: Front end Component Adaptation Based on X-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Current responsive layouts and the K-means algorithm have certain shortcomings when handling different screen sizes, such as the need for manual page adjustments, insufficient adaptability, and issues with component overlap. To address these problems, this paper introduces the X-means algorithm, which dynamically adjusts the clustering structure through the Bayesian Information Criterion, eliminating the tediousness of manually setting the value of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{k}$</tex> and making screen size grouping more precise. In this way, the X-means algorithm significantly improves adaptability, ensuring that each device receives the optimal component layout within its resolution range, thereby enhancing user experience.

articleTitle: On the Asymptotic Equivalence of Singular Values for Block Circulant and Block Toeplitz Matrices
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper investigates the asymptotic equivalence of singular values for block circulant (BC) matrices and block toeplitz (BT) matrices, which is based on the concept of asymp-totically equivalent sequences of matrices. By constructing BT matrices sequence from BC matrices sequence, we prove that the asymptotic properties of singular values for BC matrices are same as BT matrices. After that, the expression for asymptotic properties of singular values for BC matrices is given. Finally, for frequency selective multiple input multiple output (MIMO) system, the maximum value of average mutual information between transmitted signal and received signal is easily to derive, which is identical to the conclusion derived from the theory of frequency spectrum.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of OSU Service Interface Model Based on ACTN/SDOTN
publicationTitle: 2024 10th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The design and extension of YANG interface model is a hot application area at present. In this paper, we give the design ideas of YANG interface model extension, and design the interface model of OSU service to meet the needs of new service launch based on ACTN/SDOTN. After development, practical application testing verification, the interface model can quickly expand OSU services function without affecting the existing online private line services of China U nicom.
